description: Submission of the Poisons, Opium and Dangerous Drugs (Amendment) Bill and the Judicature (Amendment) Bill (Prohibition against trafficking of dangerous drugs on high seas) to Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2025‑06­‑23 to amend the Poisons, Opium and Dangerous Drugs Ordinance, No. 17 of 1929, introducing the provisions on the trafficking of dangerous drugs on the high seas and other consequential amendments, and to amend the Judicature Act, No. 2 of 1978, to confer the High Court of Sri Lanka the forum jurisdiction to hear and determine criminal prosecutions on indictment for offences committed by any person on the high seas. Accordingly, the relevant Bills have been prepared by the Legal Draftsman and the clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the said Bills. The proposal made by the Minister of Justice and National Integration to publish the said Bills in the Government Gazette and thereafter present those in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.
